note: I1, item icons (art plan batch I). 2026-10-30. One create_1_direction_object job: size 16, view top-down, palette = the 46 Apollo hexes, palette_name Apollo, name i1_items, 64 candidates, 10 generations. PixelLab review object 7dcd92f9-aa7d-4e83-ac5e-b034655935de (job 8ce39b00-faee-4362-b242-b4d6ba3b2091). All 64 frames are kept untouched in art/raw/i1/candidates/frame_<i>.png (slot order in art/raw/i1/slots.json and _slots). Every frame came back on Apollo with a 1 px dark-indigo (#1e1d39) or ramp-dark outline, but 61 of 64 fill 14x14 of the 16 px frame, over the 12x12 item envelope art:build enforces. So each pick is a recorded free hand-edit (scripts/art/itemfit.ts, parameters in _fix and art/edits/i1/fits.tsv): snap to Apollo, optional whole-colour ramp fixes, remove the most redundant whole rows and columns (or the ones named) until it fits, then close the outline in #090a14. Nothing is resampled; the raw frames stay as downloaded. Rejects fall back to code-drawn art until the anchored I2 re-roll (i_items_2.json); see _rejected.
_prompt: description: tiny game item icon, centered with an empty transparent margin, closed 1px dark navy outline, lit from upper left, no shadow. item_descriptions: the art plan's per-item lines (art.md batch I) verbatim, in PLAN 7.1 order, then 19 second slots.
_slots: 0-44 the 45 items in PLAN 7.1 order (iron_ore ... heartstone); 45-63 second slots: steel_ingot, cobalt_ingot, cold_ember_ingot, reinforced_plate, heat_shield, heartstone, copper_wire, motor, drill_bit, cobalt_drill_head, insulation, filter, cut_crystal, charged_crystal, conductive_powder, battery, circuit, resonant_core, ember_core.

_rejected.i_iron_ingot: 3: dull slate bar, only 2 px at 3:1 on the belt, no strong top highlight
_rejected.i_iron_plate: 6: plain square filling the frame, cyan corner marks instead of dark rivets (cyan is the crystal ramp)
_rejected.i_gear: 7: pale cyan and blue gear, reads as crystal, not iron (issue 6)
_rejected.i_copper_wire: 8, 51: drawn as a jar or barrel with orange coils inside
_rejected.i_reinforced_plate: 9, 48: cobalt-blue panel with a cross brace, reads as a window or as cobalt
_rejected.i_coal: 10: near-black lump with 1 px at 3:1 and no glossy facets (issue 6)
_rejected.i_steel_ingot: 11, 45: white bar shaded in navy and cyan, reads blue; mapped to the steel greys it went lumpy
_rejected.i_steel_beam: 12: drawn diagonally, 14x14; a long item may use 14 on one axis only
_rejected.i_sapstone: 15: blue rock ringed by a red-orange crust, reads as a lava donut; the resin should be amber-gold
_rejected.i_glowcap: 19: the cap is a checkerboard of transparent holes
_rejected.i_mycelium: 20: a green twisted vine, not pale fibre
_rejected.i_filter: 24, 56: leafy green disc, reads as a cabbage; no brass rim
_rejected.i_resonant_core: 32, 62: a mosaic of red, green, cyan and brass pixels
_rejected.i_cold_ember_ingot: 39, 47: mid-grey (#577277) stone-like bar, too close to iron (issue 6), no #752438 cracks
_rejected.i_ember_core: 40, 63: the two glowing vents read as a face
_rejected.i_heat_shield: 41, 49: ragged outline and stray blue and green pixels
_rejected.alternates_not_used: 14 drill_bit (bluer than 53), 18/46 cobalt_ingot (46 has a #4f8fba body, lighter than the cobalt ramp), 23/55 insulation (near-identical), 27/57 cut_crystal (near-identical), 29/58 charged_crystal (58 keeps spark specks that a closed rim turns into black dots), 30/59 conductive_powder (30 has a tail), 33/60 battery (near-identical), 34/61 circuit (34 has 2 px at 3:1), 44/50 heartstone (50 has stray green)

_replaced.i_cut_crystal: I1 frame 27 (object ff0c7db2-6c21-4b79-b07d-750c560d529e; fitted copy kept in art/edits/i1/i_cut_crystal.png) was approved, then replaced by the I2 hexagon in i_items_2.json: the I1 gem is round and at 1x reads like charged_crystal.
